title: (RHBA-2022:0618) s390utils bug fix and enhancement update
portal_summary: An update for s390utils is now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.
portal_synopsis: s390utils bug fix and enhancement update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for IBM z Systems|7|s390x
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server - Extended Life Cycle Support (for IBM z Systems)|7|s390x
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The s390utils packages contain a set of user-space utilities that should be
used together with the zSeries (s390) Linux kernel and device drivers.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* vmcp: Change sequence of failed exit (s390utils/s390-tools)
(BZ#1858868)

* dbginfo.sh: Extend data collection /proc/kallsyms and more
(s390utils/s390-tools) (BZ#1972709)

* On a RHEL 8 host running a RHEL 7.9 guest, using a vfio_ccw
DASD boot device goes into maintenance mode after soft reboot (BZ#2015429)
